Many types of financial transaction do require licensing - the sale of pension funds, other trust type funds, stocks and bonds, life insurance, real estate, sometimes even lottery tickets and stamps, for example.

If your dealer screws you, you can sue his insurance company to recover your losses. Licensed AND insured is often a minimum legal standard used by regulators in most jurisdictions.

Mandatory letter certification is another such mechanism - usually at the college or university level.
